_note: Central source of truth for platform-wide statistics. Read by home.js, analytics.js, and map.js. Do NOT hardcode these numbers elsewhere — load this file instead. Update via process_data.py or manually when data changes.

coverage._coverage_note: counties_in_database (1467) counts every record. counties_researched (870) excludes 597 records marked research_status=descriptive_only, which hold a county description but no policy research. Use counties_researched for any public coverage claim.

freshness.policy_data_update_note: Policy records are manually researched and verified from primary government sources including county council records, state legislature databases, and utility commission filings. Records are not updated on an automated schedule.
freshness.facilities_note: Facility data aggregated from public sources via automated pipeline. Not independently verified for every record. Some records may be duplicates or contain errors.

data_quality.methodology_note: County data manually researched from primary government sources. Counties without database records are shown as unresearched on the map and should not be assumed to be restriction-free.

disclaimers: Policy data is manually curated and may not reflect recent legislative changes. Always verify with primary government sources before making decisions.
Only 1,465 of 3,143 US counties have been individually researched. Counties without records are shown as unresearched and should not be assumed restriction-free.
Facility data is aggregated from public sources and may be incomplete or contain errors.
Market data for AI companies is provided via TradingView with a 15-minute delay. Not investment advice.
Zoning data covers pilot jurisdictions only (currently Loudoun County, VA). Do not rely on zoning data for permitting or legal decisions.
